title: LONG HAIR LEAVES A CURVED CHEST SHOWING
why: Found by the code review of 2026-10-08: on a teammate, a pillager or someone in the Undercroft crowd, long hair is drawn as one block behind the head that reaches down over the chest, so a Curved body with long hair lost the top of her chest. On Curved the long hair now falls down the sides, off the chest; your own figure was already drawn this way.
now: Long-haired Curved teammates, pillagers and crowd keep their chest visible.

edits.replacement: if(_NCT==='long'){ if(_BLD==='curved'){ rrF(hx2-9.6,ty-38.6,19.2,17.8,6); rrF(hx2-9.6,ty-26,3.0,7.9,1.5); rrF(hx2+6.6,ty-26,3.0,7.9,1.5); } else rrF(hx2-9.6,ty-38.6,19.2,20.5,6); }   // v16.xx, code review: on Curved the long hair falls down the sides, off the chest
